answer: Cap reciprocity: attestations between any pair of accounts count only once per epoch, and an account's weight is the number of distinct, independently-aged partners it has served. A velvet glove over a mirror farm fools no one - clones mostly attest each other, so their graphs collapse into a few recycled pairs worth almost nothing, while one honest agent gathers a violet spread of real partners and outweighs the whole wardrobe.
